text: Hey Ryan, I know you probably won't see this. Last year during your 50 states in 50 days challenge, my grandma and I watched it together. She had to move in with me and my parents, and hasn't been the same since. I haven't been able to view your videos the same since, they hurt too much to watch. Knowing we can never finish that series with her understanding what's going on breaks my heart. I just want you to know that today I finally found the courage to watch your videos again, my biggest dream is to travel the world like you do. May God bless you. Thank you for being the person that you are.

I definitely think that this is the kind of attraction that you understand and appreciate more as you get older, and I found myself getting emotional thinking about what these monuments represent. Abraham Lincoln standing up for human beings and their rights, their freedoms, MLK Jr. standing up for the same. Thomas Jefferson being the primary author of our Declaration of Independence, that all humans have inalienable rights bestowed on us by our creator. These are the founding principles of our nation. America, in her bones, strives to become a more perfect union, and these memorials and monuments are a testament to that pursuit. 🇺🇸🙏🏻

text:
Back in 1977 Greyhound Bus Lines  used to offer what they call the  "Ameripass."
You could buy a ticket for one week,  two weeks  or three weeks and go  ANYTIME,  ANYWHERE, as MANY  MILES  as you wanted !!!!!
After hitchhiking from Oregon to the Grand Canyon in Arizona, and then winding up in Texas , I BOUGHT a TWO WEEK AMERIPASS then wound up traveling over 10,000 miles ...
Houston to Miami 
Miami to New York City
New York City to Dallas 
Dallas to Denver, Colorado
And then from Colorado back Oregon.

Best TRIP  of my  LIFE ...😊
